title: High Point, NC — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

High Point is a city in NC with a population of 115,000. Furniture Capital of the World with the High Point Market and a historic downtown. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
